name: Receiving Settings Configuration
summary: Category-based Receiving settings workflow rebuilt around live behavior: entry defaults, validation rules, part formatting with reconciliation preferences, workflow defaults, and a new keyboard shortcuts page backed by reusable shared shortcut models and helpers so other workflow modules can adopt the same pattern.

userActions: Open a receiving settings category from the hub
Change the default location used at the start of Receiving
Toggle validation requirements and warning rules
Adjust minimum and maximum receiving limits
Add, edit, test, and remove auto-padding rules
Choose whether reconciliation checks all visible history
Add and remove validated ignored reconciliation locations
Enable or disable the Ctrl+T simple navigation toggle
Enable or disable InforVisual mock data when the signed-in user has Developer rights
Save or reset each settings category independently
preserveRules: Keep settings persistence routed through IService_SettingsCoreFacade for shared settings
Keep the mock-data flag routed through IService_AppSettings
Keep the existing live setting keys unchanged
Keep the part-number rule reload behavior replacing the bound collection without leaving SelectedRule stale
Keep the ignored-location validation behavior aligned with Receiving location validation
Keep workflow shortcut persistence behind IService_ReceivingShortcuts so shared shortcut models and helpers stay reusable across modules
acceptanceCriteria: Each category card opens the intended Receiving settings page
Defaults, validation, part formatting with reconciliation, and workflow defaults remain separately accessible
The keyboard shortcuts card opens the new settings page and saves per-user shortcut bindings
Metadata reflects that reconciliation scope now lives with the reconciliation preferences page instead of a separate workflow page mention
Metadata does not imply the retired hub or page names are still the active runtime workflow
validationHints: Confirm the Receiving hub opens the four new category pages
Confirm the Receiving hub opens the new Keyboard Shortcuts page
Confirm default location still loads and saves
Confirm validation toggles and numeric limits still bind correctly
Confirm auto-padding rule editing and test preview still work
Confirm ignored recommended locations still validate and persist per user
Confirm the workflow-defaults page still controls startup mode and developer-only mock data
Confirm shortcut changes persist per user and reload into the workflow at runtime
Confirm disabling the Ctrl+T toggle prevents the workflow from switching Next and Back to plain arrow keys
Confirm search destinations use the new category-based page names
reviewFocusAreas: Navigation goes to the wrong place
